During the [[Mandalorian Wars]], a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] worked as a '''caterer''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]]. In [[3969 BBY]], he served the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] from the [[Jedi Tower]].
